# Vetta 0.6.14
<!-- release-status: released 2026-11-20 -->

## English

### New

- Plugin header buttons can show more than an icon: a short label, a coloured badge, and menus with checkboxes, section labels and one level of submenu. They can also appear on the new-session page, which keeps its own header layout.
- With Git, the header shows your branch and how many files are uncommitted. Click it to switch branches, commit, or fetch, pull and push in a popover laid out like the Changes panel, with a link to open the full panel.
- In a project with designs, the header has an “Open canvas” button that opens one directly or lists them to choose from. The canvas panel now slides in at full width in one motion instead of pausing halfway.
- The question panel can be collapsed to its title, progress and current question so it no longer covers the conversation. Your answers are kept, and it expands again for the next question.

### Improvements

- Git Changes panel: the added/removed line counts now sit next to the refresh button, and on macOS the right-click menu says “Reveal in Finder”.

### Fixes

- The chat scrollbar is no longer cut off at the top and bottom by the fade, and no longer reaches up into the title bar.

## 中文

### 新增

- 插件的顶栏按钮不再只有图标：可以带一小段文字、带颜色的角标，菜单支持勾选、分组标题与一层子菜单；也能出现在新会话页，并单独记住那里的顶栏布局。
- 装了 Git 后顶栏显示当前分支和未提交文件数，点开即可切分支、提交、拉取或推送，排版与变更面板一致，并可一键打开完整面板。
- 项目里有设计稿时，顶栏多一个「打开画布」，一份直接进入、多份列出来选；画布面板改为一步以全宽滑出，不再中途停顿再拉宽。
- 询问面板可以折叠，只留标题、进度和当前问题，不再整块挡住对话；已选答案不丢，换到下一个提问会自动展开。

### 改进

- Git 变更面板：增删行数移到刷新键旁边；macOS 上右键菜单改为「在访达中显示」。

### 修复

- 会话滚动条在顶部和底部不再被渐隐吃掉一截，也不再伸进顶栏。

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/openvetta/open-vetta/compare/v0.6.13...v0.6.14
